description: Source code for the 'Item Group' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for validation, route creation, cache invalidation, and product listing functions.

classes.name: ItemGroup
classes.description: Represents an item group with methods for validation, route creation, cache management, and context generation for website display.

methods.name: autoname
methods.description: Sets the name of the item group based on its item_group_name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation, sets default parent item group if not specified, and makes route.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles actions after update, including cache invalidation and root validation.

methods.name: make_route
methods.description: Constructs the website route for the item group based on parent route and item group name.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the item group is deleted, including cache clearing.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Generates context data for website display, including product queries, filters, slideshows, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: delete_child_item_groups_key
methods.description: Deletes cache key related to child item groups.

methods.name: validate_item_group_defaults
methods.description: Validates item group default settings for the item group.
